prompts.prompt: Production sprite plate for the approved Ghost ship. EDIT the supplied concept: isolate ONLY the entire ship, retaining its exact level broadside silhouette, bow LEFT, raised stern RIGHT, rotted dark timber with mint-jade seam glow, two masts, tattered mint translucent sails, skull insignia, spectral mermaid figurehead, horizontally left-projecting plank, central capstan and right wheel. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. REMOVE all sea, foam, scenery, sky, clouds, rain, moon, fish, jellyfish. REMOVE ALL people, skeleton crew, sleepers, birds, lantern glyphs and floating magical smoke: those are separate animated assets. Retain lantern hooks but no light objects. Four large EMPTY cutaway cabins across lower hull, black-teal interiors and empty hammocks, no residents and no interior lamps. Leave the main deck wide, unobstructed and perfectly horizontal with a clear 35-pixel deep walkable plank surface in final game scale; leave raised stern deck broad enough for several sprites. Open hatch remains a dark opening. The rope ladder is perfectly VERTICAL against the main mast and BEHIND sail cloth, so the sail occludes it in the middle. Keep every mast tip and flag fully inside image with transparent margins. Crisp pixel-art, same quality/detail as approved concept, clean pixel clusters, designed to register to 740x400 logical-pixel game stage later. Neutral pale-green daylight art (night tint added by engine). No text, labels, border, shadows outside ship or checkerboard pixels. Preserve the approved ship's identifiable design, no new perspective.

Production character sprite atlas, crisp 16-bit pixel art, TRUE transparent background. EIGHT ROWS and EIGHT COLUMNS in a precise uniform 8 by 8 GRID, NO dividers or text, all cells same size with ample transparent padding. Each ROW is ONE distinct friendly ghost pirate design maintained identically across eight poses. Rows top to bottom: 1 translucent mint tricorne captain with long coat; 2 ivory friendly skeleton with red bandana; 3 round lantern-eyed hooded sailor with short navy coat; 4 pale green spectral woman pirate with wide brim purple hat; 5 friendly skeleton with blue bicorne and striped shirt; 6 stocky sea-green ghost with mustard souwester; 7 thin ghost with tall dark hat and turquoise waistcoat; 8 friendly skeleton with teal scarf and ponytail. Eight columns left to right ALWAYS these poses: front standing; side walking right left-foot-forward; side walking right right-foot-forward; hauling capstan handle arms extended right; hauling arms bent right; waiting hand on hip looking left; climbing a ladder facing away with arms raised (do not draw ladder); falling with arms up legs together. Each full body fully within its cell, consistent body scale and baseline per row, each figure about 24 logical pixels tall later. Pixel outlines ivory/mint and muted teal shadow, transparent wispy body edges, luminous eyes; spooky fun no gore. Clearly recognizable same eight characters. No ground, shadows, props, ladders, scenery, glow clouds or lettering. Neutral pale colours suitable for night multiplication. Wide landscape image with 64 readable individually separated figures.

Production sky texture atlas for Ghost ship pixel-art game. ONE IMAGE divided exactly into THREE equal COLUMNS and TWO equal ROWS, six edge-to-edge rectangular sky panels with NO gaps, borders, labels or text. Each panel is a smooth subtly dithered pixel-art sky gradient, NOT horizontal bands; NO ocean, horizon line, land, ships, buildings, clouds or fog (those are separate animated layers). Same composition and scale in all six panels. Top row left DAWN grey lavender to muted peach with pale low sun; top row middle MORNING cool silvery blue-grey with pale sun; top row right MIDDAY moody silver-grey with hazy ivory sun in upper left. Bottom row left AFTERNOON desaturated slate teal with pale warmer sun; bottom row middle DUSK smoky violet and muted mauve at bottom, no sun; bottom row right NIGHT midnight indigo sky with large textured pale moon in upper left and many fine pixel stars evenly scattered across WHOLE panel from top edge to bottom edge and left to right, never clustered in one corner. Keep gradients subtle, moody and beautiful. Night dark enough that jade lanterns shine, stars not giant lens flares. Clean high-quality 16-bit pixel art with delicate dither texture and no hard gradient bands. Opaque background, landscape 3:2 atlas, exact equal-sized panels, no rounded corners. These are six complete sky fills, not a poster or six illustrated scenes.

Production haunted-island scrolling silhouette plate for the approved Ghost ship game. Use the approved haunted panorama design: five distinct landmarks LEFT TO RIGHT graveyard isle, skull rock, ruined Gothic chapel, ship graveyard with broken masts, ghost-lit lighthouse. One long continuous archipelago, crisp beautiful detailed pixel art. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, remove ALL sky, stars, clouds, mist, water, reflections, underwater objects and foreground rocks. Keep ONLY these five islands/buildings and their attached rock bases, all standing on ONE perfectly horizontal waterline along bottom of plate. Narrow sea gaps between islands are transparent. Rocks end at waterline, do not draw the sea. The five landmarks fill center 90% of width, leave 5% completely transparent on each edge so coast can loop across open-water gaps. Night neutral violet/slate stone with moss, emerald window lights and lighthouse lamp; NO lighthouse beam (animated separately). No people, no animal, no flying ghost, no moon. Keep the graveyard modest, the chapel broken and roofless, the ship graveyard visibly multiple wrecks. Level side-on distant side-scrolling perspective. Landscape panorama 3:1. No lettering, borders or labels. This is a game parallax sprite layer, never a flattened scene.

Production water texture atlas for a spectral pirate pixel-art game, exact TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, six equal wide rectangular panels without borders or text. Left column calm water, right column storm variant of corresponding row. Top row: distant haunted teal ocean, fine irregular overlapping wave crests with depth, not repeated dashes; calm misty steel-teal at left, fierce slate-navy wind-swept at right. Middle row: medium-distance broad curling waves, indigo/teal dark troughs, cyan irregular foam; storm at right has bigger more dramatic green-lit breaking wave shapes. Bottom row: close foreground waves viewed at low side-on waterline, translucent deep teal and rounded foamy breaking crests; storm at right has powerful curling whitecaps and jade spray. Every panel is completely filled with water, NO sky, NO horizon, NO coast, NO creatures, NO boats, NO isolated foam on transparent background. All edges of each panel blend into neighboring waves for horizontal seamless repeat. Rich layered wave shapes, restrained 16-bit pixel-art palette, clean dither clusters. Match approved Ghost ship's beautiful navy-teal sea and green spectral lighting, rather than tropical blue. Opaque square atlas with six wide panels, each panel uniformly registered in equal 2x3 grid.

Production sprite animation sheet for Ghost ship's skeletal KRAKEN departure. TRUE transparent background. Exact FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, EIGHT equal cells, no dividers or text. ONE consistent friendly-spooky giant skeletal cephalopod with a skull-like head, huge glowing green eyes, a central open mouth and long bone-segment tentacles, matching approved green-whirlpool ghost pirate theme. Each cell SAME canvas and fixed waterline at 78 percent of cell height; monster registration stays same across frames. Sequential frames in reading order: 1 ONLY a green whirlpool ripple, NO monster; 2 skull tip and two tentacle tips surface through green water; 3 half head and four bone tentacles rise; 4 full huge skull and six tentacles reared, mouth open; 5 two tentacles curl inward round empty central mouth area to capture a separate actor, mouth open; 6 mouth closing, tentacles curl downward as head descends; 7 almost entirely submerged with just crown sinking behind opaque green wave; 8 ONLY fading oval green ripple and mist, ABSOLUTELY NO eyes, head or tentacle visible. Do NOT draw a pirate anywhere: engine draws it separately. Each monster visibly IN the water: opaque teal/green wave and mist occlude its lower anatomy in every pose, a real horizontal surface split, not a floating monster. Compact luminous emerald whirlpool ring surrounds base; no ocean rectangle. Keep head/eyes/mouth design identical across frames, body 5x a tiny game crewmate, no gore. Beautiful crisp 16-bit pixel art, limited jade/ivory/teal palette, no smooth paint. Landscape sheet. Transparent gaps between all sprites.
